app.name: Sorot
gpu.notice: This machine has no graphics acceleration, so effects are reduced and previews open in your video player.
home.title: Clip a new video
home.sub: Drop a video or paste a link. Sorot picks the best moments and makes 9:16 clips with subtitles.
home.drop.title: Drop a video here
home.drop.hint: MP4, MKV, MOV or WebM. Or press Ctrl+O to choose a file.
home.link.label: Video link
home.dir.label: Direction for choosing clips (optional)
home.dir.hint: Example: find the funny moments, skip the ads
home.dir.note: At most 500 characters. The direction is also used when screening, choosing and writing post copy.
home.opts.title: Import options
home.opts.captions.sub: Used when there are any, in place of transcribing.
home.empty.next: Paste a link or choose a file to make your first clips.
home.err.direction: The direction is {n} characters; the limit is {max}.
home.err.link: Paste a link that starts with http:// or https://.
home.err.link.next: Copy the video's address from the browser and paste it here.
home.err.file: {name} is not a video Sorot can read (mp4, mov, mkv or webm).
home.err.file.next: Drop another file, or paste a link.
home.err.disk.next: Free some space on the drive that holds the data folder, then import again.
home.err.engine.next: Check the engine, then import again.
job.sub: Clipping this video. It is safe to close the window; the work carries on.
job.view.note: See clips turns on once the Subtitle stage is done.
job.interrupted: The engine stopped while this job ran. Try again starts it over.
stage.SUBTITLE: Subtitle
stages.label: Stages
clips.title: Clips from {video}
clips.sub: Ordered by score. Choose a clip to preview it and decide which to post.
clips.filtered.next: Choose another tab to see the other clips.
clips.empty.next: When a job finishes, its clips show here, best first.
clips.stage.label: Preview 9:16
clips.note.cpu: Previews open in your video player. Press Play.
clips.save.title: Save the clip
clips.save.fail: Could not open the save dialog: {why}
editor.title: Edit clip: {title}
editor.sub: Change what needs changing, then render again. The preview never touches the original file.
editor.timeline.sub: The bright marker is the hook moment.
editor.timeline.label: Timeline, {t} long
editor.hook.note: The hook plays first as a teaser, then the clip starts from the beginning.
editor.note.kept: The earlier export stays until you export again.
editor.unchanged: Nothing changed since the last render.
editor.rendered: Rendered again. The earlier export stays until you export again.
editor.missing.next: Go back to the clips and choose one.
settings.title: Settings
conn.sub: Everything here is optional for clipping. Generate needs an AI connection.
conn.llm.title: LLM (OpenAI-compatible endpoint)
conn.jev.title: Jev quality gate
conn.tebar.title: Tebar (publishing)
conn.llm.about: Writes post copy, reviews clips and can direct the picks. Off: the rules do it.
conn.jev.about: Answers fixed questions about each clip and checks copy. Off: text rules answer them.
conn.tebar.about: Posts to the accounts you connected at tebar.app. Off: download clips and post them yourself.
conn.key-about: The key is shown as the engine masks it. Typing replaces it; leaving it empty keeps it.
conn.saved: Saved. The next action uses it; no restart needed.
conn.not-saved: Not saved: {why}. Check the value and save again.
conn.failed: Failed: {why}. Check the address and key, then test again.
conn.kenari.no-account: Balance and usage aren't available for this key (it may be restricted).
gen.sub: How Generate runs on this machine, its voice, images and commands, and what it may spend.
gen.read-failed: Could not read the Generate settings.
gen.status.title: Generate on this machine
gen.status.unavailable: Generate cannot run yet. Fix these, then open this page again.
gen.models.title: Models
gen.models.about: A shot starts at the highest level. These numbers show how a model fares; pin a weak one lower.
gen.models.empty: No model has run yet. Calibrate the connected model to see how it fares.
gen.models.record: {level}: asked {asked}, first time {first}, repaired {repaired}, dropped {dropped}, malformed {malformed}
gen.models.cal-running: Calibrating. This takes a few minutes; the table updates by itself.
gen.models.cal-done: Calibrated {model}. The table above shows the result.
gen.budgets.title: Budgets and models per role
gen.budgets.about: Empty means the main LLM model.
gen.budgets.saved: Saved. The next Generate build uses it.
voice.title: Narration voice
voice.about: Speaks the script of a narrated video. One engine at a time; each language has its own voice.
voice.none-yet: No engine yet: videos cannot be narrated, and recipes that need a voice are unavailable.
voice.engine.elevenlabs: ElevenLabs (word times come with the voice)
voice.base-url: Base URL (optional for ElevenLabs and Fish)
voice.local-note: KittenTTS speaks English with a built-in voice. It has no Indonesian voice: for Indonesian, put the path of a 5 to 30 s recording of one speaker in the field below and it is cloned, or use an online engine.
image.title: Scene images
image.about: Any OpenAI-compatible /images/generations service, Kenari included. A shot that asks for a picture gets one; without this its fallback visual is drawn.
cmd.title: Custom commands
cmd.about: Your own checks. A recipe can name one of these; it is run on a build with --project-dir and --version-dir and prints its findings as JSON. A shared recipe can never add one.
cmd.off: Custom commands are off on this install (the server's admin enables them).
cmd.name: Name
cmd.timeout-bad: A time limit must be a whole number
publish.title: Publish: {clip}
publish.sub: Write the copy, make your choices, then post. Nothing is sent automatically.
publish.close-reopen: {why}. Close this and open it again.
publish.accounts.title: Connected accounts
publish.accounts.about: A post goes to one Tebar workspace. Once you pick an account, the others in other workspaces are off.
publish.off: Tebar is not connected. Connect it in Settings, Connections, or download the clip and post it yourself.
publish.no-accounts: No accounts yet. Connect TikTok, Instagram or YouTube at tebar.app, then open this again.
publish.count: {n} characters. The engine cuts anything over the platform limit.
publish.choices.title: Your choices
publish.choices.about: These stay empty until you fill them. Sorot picks nothing for you.
publish.tiktok.how: How to send it to TikTok
publish.tiktok.draft: Send as a draft to the TikTok app
publish.tiktok.who: Who can see it on TikTok
publish.privacy-unchosen: Not chosen yet: pick who can see it, or send it as a draft.
publish.youtube.title: YouTube title
publish.kids-unanswered: Not answered yet: YouTube asks this for every upload.
publish.gate.fail: Post anyway: the quality gate held this clip back
publish.gate.review: I checked it: the quality gate asks for a review
publish.schedule-invalid: The schedule is not a real date and time. Check the boxes, or leave them empty to post now.
publish.ready: Ready. Nothing is sent until you press the button.
publish.stays-off: The button stays off until every choice above is made.
publish.posts.title: Earlier posts
publish.posts.empty: No posts for this clip yet. They appear here after you post.
publish.generated.title: Generated videos
publish.generated.soon: Coming with Generate: videos Generate makes will be publishable from here.
feedback.title: Log results
feedback.about: The score is counted per day online, so the post time is required and cannot be in the future.
feedback.time-missing: Add when it was posted. The score counts days online, so this is required.
feedback.time-invalid: The post time is not a real date and time. Check the boxes.
feedback.time-future: The post time cannot be in the future.
feedback.saved-no-score: Saved. The engine has no score for it yet.
learning.title: Learning
learning.sub: Tell Sorot how your posts did, and it scores the next clips by what worked.
learning.teach.title: Teach Sorot what works
learning.teach.about: Log how a posted clip did. With {n} results Sorot can retrain its scoring on what your audience watches.
learning.progress-ready: {have} of {n} results logged, ready to retrain
learning.version-trained: Scoring version {v}, last retrained on {n} results.
learning.train-failed: Retraining failed: {why}. Try again, or log more results first.
learning.results.title: Logged results
learning.results.empty: Nothing logged yet. Post a clip, then log how it did under Waiting for results.
learning.waiting.title: Waiting for results
learning.waiting.empty: No exported clips are waiting. Export a clip, post it, then come back to log how it did.
discover.sub: Find videos worth clipping, queue the good ones, and start them.
discover.find.title: Find videos
discover.goal-hint: Leave empty and Sorot decides from your past clips
discover.query-hint: A topic, a name, a question
discover.trending-about: Trending videos in Indonesia, read from YouTube.
discover.auto-about: Auto researches what is trending (web and YouTube), reads the whole captions of promising videos and picks the ones worth clipping, with a reason for each. It uses the LLM when one is configured, otherwise the algorithm.
discover.enrich-about: Results persist across sessions. Top candidates are scored from their whole captions in the background; a predicted score appears a few seconds later and reflects the video content, not just the title.
discover.type-query: Type what to search for, then press Discover.
discover.paste-channel: Paste a channel link, then press Discover.
discover.run.running: Researching. This takes a minute; the list fills in when it is done.
discover.run.failed: The run failed: {why}. Run it again.
discover.llm-error: The LLM did not answer ({why}), so the rules picked.
discover.empty-next: Run a search, trending, a channel or Auto-discover above.
discover.start-about: Starting imports each queued video and begins its job.
